item.title: Move session tuning flags to config defaults
item.intent: Flags like max-failures, warm-retry, auto-review, no-summary are session preferences — hide from default help, document as config-first with flag override
steps: Verify all session flags have config.yaml equivalents
Remove session flags from default help, keep in help --full
Make the pr flag imply no-merge automatically
acceptanceCriteria: Default help for run shows only essential flags
Session tuning flags still work as CLI overrides
